purpose: Debt Service Coverage Ratio and Interest Coverage Ratio suite: Basic/Cash/FCF DSCR, Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio (FCCR), EBIT- and EBITDA-basis ICR, and Net/Gross Leverage, evaluated against a published lender threshold matrix (investment grade, leveraged loan, CRE, infrastructure, SME/mid-market). Provable node counterpart to tools/438-dscr-interest-coverage-calculator.html.
